## Description
Provide a summary of the changes and the reasoning behind them. Link to any related issues (e.g. `Closes #12`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Code refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's styling and typescript guidelines.
- [ ] I have run `npm run check:all` locally and verified there are no formatting or clippy compiler warnings.
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed successfully (`npm test` and `cargo test`).
- [ ] I have updated any relevant documentation files (`Decisions.md`, `progress-tracker.md`) if applicable.

## Screenshots / Video Walkthrough (if UI changes are made)
Include screenshots or recordings demonstrating the new UI behavior.
